description: This file implements UBUS context management and invocation functions for the bbfdm API, including initialization, freeing, synchronous and asynchronous invocation, and event sending.

methods.name: int bbfdm_init_ubus_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the UBUS context within the bbfdm context by establishing a connection.

methods.name: int bbfdm_free_ubus_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Frees the UBUS context in the bbfdm context if it exists.

methods.name: int bbfdm_ubus_invoke_sync(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_attr * msg,int timeout,bbfdm_ubus_cb data_callback,void * callback_args)
methods.description: Performs a synchronous UBUS invoke call with the specified object, method, message, and callback.

methods.name: int bbfdm_ubus_invoke_async(struct ubus_context * ubus_ctx,const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_attr * msg,bbfdm_ubus_cb data_callback,bbfdm_ubus_async_cb complete_callback)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous UBUS invoke call, setting up callbacks for data and completion.

methods.name: int bbfdm_ubus_send_event(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * obj,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Sends a UBUS event message for the specified object.
